newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH BONDS AND MARKKA CLOSE LITTLE CHANGED.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH BONDS AND MARKKA CLOSE LITTLE CHANGED.

text.p: The bond market was quiet and
confined to range trade as German players were on holiday and
there was little to trade on, dealers said.
Focus was on Friday's September non-farm payrolls which
economists in a Reuters poll expected to have grown by 166,000
compared to 250,000 in August. Slower-than-expected growth in
employment could boost U.S. bonds and help Finnish bonds narrow
the yield gap over Germany, one dealer said.
Forex dealers said the markka had slight bias to strengthen
if U.S. rate hike fears return and boost the dollar. A dollar
dip on the other hand was less likely to send the markka lower.
